name: 02115 · Boston, MA
findings: ZIP 02115 (Boston) has 214 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 75 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02115 (Boston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few religious organizations list public events
observations.text: No religious organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Health care organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 21 health care organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
